bug_summary: creditCardのMastercard用正規表現が非キャプチャグループで囲われておらず、`|`の優先順位により`5[1-5]\d{2}`の分岐に末尾アンカーが効かず不正な長さのMastercard番号を許容してしまうバグ
pr_diff:
diff --git a/library/src/actions/creditCard/creditCard.ts b/library/src/actions/creditCard/creditCard.ts
index 09803523..1193ebd2 100644
--- a/library/src/actions/creditCard/creditCard.ts
+++ b/library/src/actions/creditCard/creditCard.ts
@@ -85,7 +85,8 @@ const PROVIDER_REGEX_LIST = [
   // JCB
   /^(?:2131|1800|35\d{3})\d{11}$/u,
   // Mastercard
-  /^(?:5[1-5]\d{2}|222\d|22[3-9]\d|2[3-6]\d{2}|27[01]\d|2720)\d{12}$/u,
+  // eslint-disable-next-line redos-detector/no-unsafe-regex
+  /^5[1-5]\d{2}|(?:222\d|22[3-9]\d|2[3-6]\d{2}|27[01]\d|2720)\d{12}$/u,
   // UnionPay
   /^(?:6[27]\d{14,17}|81\d{14,17})$/u,
   // Visa
pr_description: Reworks the Mastercard branch of PROVIDER_REGEX_LIST, dropping the outer non-capturing group around the alternation and keeping the digit-count suffix attached to the second half of the pattern. Also adds a redos-detector lint suppression matching the other provider patterns in the list.
